title: Workers stop appending refused-run notes to a host-finding bug, whose notes fill to the cap, and name the test.run rows in their report instead
goal: The worker rules (bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES) tell a worker whose whole-suite run is refused over seconds to name the run's test.run row id in its report and add no note to the open host-finding bug (SP-waxgh3kg: five workers appended to BG-qnbcyw72 until its notes reached TEXT_MAX and the review's own finding could not be added); the review files one host finding per sprint as the skill says; a test of brief ID asserts the rule's line.

run:
import sys,re
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_dispatch
rules=bl_dispatch.worker_rules('.','ST-x','work/ST-x',100)
sys.exit(0 if any('test.run' in r and re.search(r'host[- ]finding',r) and 'refused' in r for r in rules) else 1)
